decisions.quote: Previous studies have demonstrated that CW-FIT produced improvements in student appropriate classroom behaviors which led to increased available instruction time. The purpose of this investigation was to systematically replicate CW-FIT adding to the empirical research base supporting it.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist at the listed paths. The supplied source text is a publisher preview containing only the title, abstract, and reference list, without the article body (Introduction, Methods, Results, or Discussion). While the abstract states that the investigation systematically replicates CW-FIT and contrasts its measurement of specific student skills with 'prior studies', it does not name which specific prior CW-FIT study or studies are empirically retested. The reference list contains six prior CW-FIT publications: Kamps et al. (2010, Journal of Positive Behavior Interventions, 13, 154-167, which corresponds to shipped row input_row_index 82, DOI 10.1177/1098300711398935), Wills et al. (2010), Wills et al. (2014), Kamps, Conklin, & Wills (2015a), Kamps et al. (2015b, DOI 10.1177/1098300714565244), and Weeden et al. (in press). Without the primary text body, it cannot be determined whether the study empirically retests only shipped row 82 or instead/additionally retests one or more of the other five CW-FIT studies in the bibliography.
